decision_semantics.accepted: The cited evidence and claim satisfy the specific tile contract.
decision_semantics.disputed: The mapping cannot be resolved safely from the frozen context.
decision_semantics.rejected: Literal overlap exists, but the evidence and claim do not satisfy the tile contract.

notes: All eight candidates were proposed by the deterministic literal mapping policy.
Seven Vercel mappings reuse one mission claim across mission and core-purpose tiles.
One Robin Capital mapping covers a mission detection tile.
Literal overlap is necessary but not sufficient for semantic tile support.
This v1 set has only two brands, two claim variants, and supports polarity.
No result from this dataset has runtime, scoring, or canonical-selection authority.
